content.text:
Excellent! All 82 tests pass ✓

**Added VAT support:**
- `lineVat(line)` — calculates VAT on line amount after discount, rounded per line
- `invoiceTotals()` now returns `{ subtotal, discount, vat, total }` where total = subtotal - discount + vat
- VAT calculation per line (not percentage of invoice total)

**Updated `renderInvoiceText()` to show:**
- Invoice number or "DRAFT"
- Customer name
- Line items
- Subtotal (always)
- Discount (only if > 0)
- VAT (only if > 0)
- Total

**Tests cover:**
- VAT calculation with and without discounts
- Mixed VAT rates (21%, 9%, 0%)
- Per-line rounding
- Rendering format with optional discount/VAT lines
